resources.title: Full Stack React Hooks & Modern State Architecture Guide
resources.description: Original in-depth study guide covering useState, useEffect lifecycle patterns, custom hooks, Context API, and state caching best practices.
resources.bestFor: Frontend developers and full-stack semester exams

resources.title: Cloud Computing Infrastructure & Virtualization Primer
resources.description: Original handbook on IaaS, PaaS, SaaS models, Hypervisor types, AWS EC2/S3 architecture, containerization vs VMs, and auto-scaling rules.
resources.bestFor: Cloud semester exams and AWS Cloud Practitioner prep

resources.title: Information Security Cryptography & Network Defense Handbook
resources.description: Original notes covering Symmetric vs Asymmetric encryption (AES, RSA), Hashing (SHA-256), Digital Signatures, Firewalls, and SSL/TLS handshakes.
resources.bestFor: Information security exams and security analyst interviews

resources.title: NPTEL Cloud Computing Course by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. Soumya Kanti Ghosh complete lectures on cloud principles, service models, virtualization, OpenStack, and SLA management.
resources.bestFor: University cloud computing syllabus and certifications

resources.title: NPTEL Cryptography and Network Security by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. Debdeep Mukhopadhyay covering classical ciphers, DES, AES, public-key cryptosystems, RSA, ECC, and key management.

resources.title: NPTEL Internet Technology Course by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Lectures by Prof. Indranil Sengupta on web architecture, client-server models, HTTP protocols, HTML5/CSS, JavaScript, and CGI/servlets.

resources.title: MIT 6.042J Mathematics for Computer Science
resources.description: Discrete mathematics, proof methods, graph theory, state machines, probability, and counting techniques foundational for IT algorithms.
resources.bestFor: Mathematical rigour and computer science theory

resources.title: NPTEL Software Engineering by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. Rajib Mall lectures on Waterfall vs Agile, Requirement Engineering, Function-Oriented Design, Object Modeling, and Testing metrics.

resources.title: NPTEL Data Mining by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Lectures on data preprocessing, association rule mining (Apriori), classification (Decision Trees, Naive Bayes), and clustering (K-Means, DBSCAN).

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks Full Stack Web Development Roadmap
resources.description: Structured guide covering frontend HTML/CSS/JS/React, backend Node.js, databases, authentication, and hosting workflows.

resources.title: CodeWithHarry React.js Complete Course with Real Projects
resources.description: Hindi playlist building real applications with React components, props, state, hooks, router, and deployment.

resources.title: NPTEL Introduction to Internet of Things by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. Sudip Misra lectures covering sensing, actuation, IoT networking protocols (MQTT, CoAP), Raspberry Pi, and Cloud IoT integration.
resources.bestFor: IoT semester course and capstone projects

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks Mobile App Development with Flutter Guide
resources.description: Tutorial on cross-platform mobile development, widget tree, stateful vs stateless widgets, navigation, and API integration.

resources.title: NPTEL Big Data Computing by IIT Patna
resources.description: Lectures on Big Data ecosystems, Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS), MapReduce execution, Apache Spark, and NoSQL databases.
resources.bestFor: Big Data architecture and distributed storage

resources.title: GeeksforGeeks Docker and Containerization Tutorial
resources.description: Detailed guide on Dockerfile creation, image building, multi-stage builds, container networking, and docker-compose files.
resources.bestFor: DevOps practical workflows and container management
